east_catalysts_risks.notes: No in-window (18 Oct 06:00 to 21 Oct 06:00 IST) developments could be verified. The Whitefield advocate-shooting lead (Asianet Newsable, 19 Oct) did not turn up in any search result. The TOI lead was blocked and is undated, and may be an older story. It is a crime item and not a verified property-market catalyst. The claims above are background published 16 Oct or earlier. Searches on the Blue Line, Business Corridor (PRR), Sarjapur-Hebbal metro, STRR/Hoskote, Cauvery Stage 5, Varthur/Bellandur flooding and ORR traffic returned only older items. Several search summaries mention 2026 items (the BBC land-acquisition and tender stage, the Sarjapur-Hebbal revised report, the STRR girder approval, 20 June 2026 flooding), but I could not open those pages or quote them, so they are not reported as claims. Deccan Herald pages returned 403.

east_launches_prices.notes: No East Bengaluru launch, new phase or price quote published or updated within 18-21 Oct 2026 was found. Several searches failed and were not re-run (Panathur/Balagere/KR Puram, Bellandur/Varthur news, thehindu.com, ET Realty). I did not search the developer sites or rera.karnataka.gov.in directly. Both advocate-shooting leads could not be verified: the TOI page was blocked and no search surfaced the Asianet story. They are crime or property-dispute items, not market data, so I reported no claims on them. The three claims are background only, with true dates shown.

north_south_west.notes: The only verified in-window item is the NGT halt on Hebbal tunnel tree felling. The order itself was passed 16 Oct, before the window; reports were published 18 Oct. The Hindu pages (NGT halt, 1,500+ objections on 20 Oct) could not be fetched, so the 1,500-objections claim is unverified. The two Hindu articles are the only primary reports of the halt, and the Vartha Bharati and Indian Opinion excerpts are headline-level. No verified villa, plot or apartment launches were found in the window: searches returned only stale aggregator listings, so none were recorded. Trade Brains pieces (Hosur/Attibele, Jigani), Hulimavu flooding, the Kanakapura Road tanker fire, Kengeri traffic curbs, and the airport ganja bust were not surfaced by search, so none were reported. Many searches errored, so coverage is incomplete. This is not proof that nothing else happened.

social_signals.notes: No in-window (18–21 Oct 2026) social or video content about East Bengaluru property could be found or verified. Reddit blocked WebFetch. YouTube rendered no results. LinkedIn needs a login. Web searches, including site-targeted ones, returned only developer or portal blogs (Brigade, Sobha, NBR, Godrej, JLL Homes) and older items. Examples are an April 2025 Reddit-derived story on a Rs 1.2 crore East Bangalore flat and an August 2026 NLMC/JLL listing for 44.03 acres on Old Madras Road, which I could not open. I reported no claims because I had no verbatim excerpts I could tie to a dated, in-window publication, and I did not want to pass promotional blog text off as social signals. This is a valid "nothing verifiable" result for the window, not proof that nothing was posted. A manual check of r/bangalore, YouTube and LinkedIn is needed.
